name: std::filesystem::hard_link_count
intro:
Returns the number of hard links for the filesystem object identified by path p.

The non-throwing overload returns static_cast<uintmax_t>(-1) on errors.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
p

 -

 path to examine


 ec

 -

 out-parameter for error reporting in the non-throwing overload

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of hard links for p.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
Any overload not marked noexcept may throw std::bad_alloc if memory allocation fails.

1) Throws std::filesystem::filesystem_error on underlying OS API errors, constructed with p as the first path argument and the OS error code as the error code argument.

2) Sets a std::error_code& parameter to the OS API error code if an OS API call fails, and executes ec.clear() if no errors occur.

examples.output:
Number of hard links for current path is 2
Number of hard links for .. is 3

summary: Returns the number of hard links for the filesystem object identified by path p.
